title: Checkmate

card.idea: Checkmate is check with no way out. The king is attacked, he has nowhere safe to go, nothing can block the line, and nothing can take the attacker. Checkmate ends the game on the spot.
card.habit: Check first, then ask whether any of the three ways out is left.

explain.text: The queen on c8 checks along the eighth rank. The king cannot step to e7 or f7 because the white king covers them, g7 and g8 are covered by the queen, and nothing can block or take. That is checkmate.
This one looks similar and is not mate. The queen on g2 checks the king on g3, but the king can step to f4 or h4 — and nothing defends the queen, so he can even take her. Check, not checkmate.

hints.text2: Three squares work. One of them is a capture.

wrong.Re7+: The king simply steps to d8 or f8. A mating check has to leave him nothing.

challenges.reason: The rook checks along the eighth rank, the white king on e6 covers d7, e7 and f7, and f8 is still on the rook's rank.

wrong.Qh5+: The black queen blocks on f7 and you have lost your moment.

challenges.reason: The queen reaches the eighth rank from far away. The white king on e6 has already taken d7, e7 and f7, and d8 is still on the queen's line.

wrong.Kb6: Quiet moves give Black a free hand. There is a mate on the board right now.

challenges.reason: The rook checks along the eighth rank and the white king on a6 covers b7, so the king in the corner has nowhere to go.

takeaway: Checkmate is check where none of the three ways out is left.
